_what_this_is: A body that means to end its issue and says so in the one place this rule leaves for it: the start of a line. It has to pass, and it is the direction proof. A rule written over the closing keywords alone, without the position, refuses this and refuses every deliberate landing on this board with it.
title: Build the match index at start and rebuild it on every sweep
body:
Closes #29.

The fourth condition was the last one open, and the sweep that keeps the
index current is what meets it.
